subject: iso/candidate/processing_demand_store_rev2.py
authority: OWNER_DECISIONS.md section 13 T1-1 (OPEN-2 option A) and T1-2 (OPEN-1 option A)
nature: INDEPENDENT EXPECTATION — frozen BEFORE running the revised candidate. Expected values below are hand-derived from the ruling text, NOT generated by calling the candidate.
proposition_under_test: After applying OPEN-2 option A, two requests that differ ONLY in as_of_date must NOT be merged into the same demand row.

cases.case: same source, SAME request, submitted twice
cases.rationale: W06A-P2 requires that a resubmitted identical request reuses the same active demand id.

cases.case: same source, requests differ ONLY in as_of_date (the exact c8/c9/c10 defect)
cases.rationale: OPEN-2 option A: the key MUST include request identity. Measured v1 behaviour: both returned demand-84179f79057143d4 (MERGE) — that is the defect this case must now fail on.

v1_measured_counterexample.note: the row kept the FIRST request's sha while the SECOND request was what was actually submitted

cases.case: same source, requests differ in the TARGET (document_kind), as_of_date equal
cases.rationale: The ruling names `target` as part of the request identity. Two targets are two demands.

cases.case: same source, requests differ only in an UNLISTED future field
cases.rationale: payload_sha256 must cover unlisted fields so a new field is NOT silently ignored. Fail-safe direction: err toward a new demand, never toward a silent merge.

cases.case: attempt ledger records at the real call boundary
cases.rationale: W05C-N2: a failed call that produced no artifact must still be counted. The ledger must show attempts=2 even when artifact rows = 0 or 1.

must_not_be: a triple of (source_sha256, review_policy, role_set) alone — that is the v1 insufficient shape

negative_control.description: A candidate that reverts the key to the v1 triple must turn R2-N1 / R2-N2 / R2-N3 RED. If they stay green, the test does not actually test the ruling.
